# Najesty Design & Pictures

> Canadian studio for interior design, decoration, home staging and photography. Spaces you feel before you describe them. Site available in French (default) and English.

## Primary market

- Canada (design remote nationwide; on-site styling where local)
- Remote design for clients in Europe and Africa

## Pages (FR)

- [Home](https://najesty.ca/): brand and signatures
- [Work](https://najesty.ca/work): projects by expertise
- [Vision](https://najesty.ca/vision): philosophy — strategy, identity, design + FAQ
- [Studio](https://najesty.ca/atelier): approach, services, method
- [Method](https://najesty.ca/methode): remote design vs on-site styling
- [Blog](https://najesty.ca/blogue): 25 guides for Canadian homes, sellers, hospitality, Europe & Africa remote
- [Contact](https://najesty.ca/contact): bonjour@najesty.ca

## Pages (EN)

- [Home](https://najesty.ca/en/): English home

## Services

- Interior design (remote across Canada; Europe & Africa remote)
- Decoration
- Home staging
- Photography
- Sourcing and shopping
- Styling and installation (Canada local)
